settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: All orders are placed on zeyov.com. Add your tee to the cart and check out — it takes under a minute. We don't take orders over WhatsApp or social media; WhatsApp is for support only.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and wallets through Razorpay, plus Cash on Delivery. Delivery is free on every order, including Cash on Delivery — no extra charge.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No. You can check out as a guest, track your order and write a review without an account. Signing in is optional and simply keeps all your orders in one place.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: Yes, until your order is dispatched. Contact us as soon as possible with your order number. Once dispatched, the order can't be cancelled, but our 7-day size exchange applies after delivery.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: In-stock tees are packed and dispatched within 1–2 days, then delivered in 3–7 days depending on your pin code. Made-to-order or pre-booked embroidery designs take about 2 weeks; we confirm the dispatch date on WhatsApp.

settings.question: Do you deliver across India?
settings.answer: Yes, we deliver to almost every pin code in India. Remote areas can take a day or two longer.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Open your order email and tap View your order, or visit Track Order and share your order number. No login needed.

settings.question: What is your exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 7-day size exchange: if your tee doesn't fit, request a different size within 7 days of delivery. The tee must be unworn, unwashed and in its original packaging, with the Zeyov tag still attached. Damaged or wrong items are replaced free. Custom tees designed in Zeyov Studio can't be exchanged for size.

settings.question: Why does the tag matter?
settings.answer: The Zeyov tag is our proof that a tee hasn't been worn or washed. Please try your tee on with the tag still on. If the tag has been removed, cut or its seal broken, we can't accept an exchange.

settings.question: Do you give refunds?
settings.answer: Refunds apply only when a replacement isn't possible or an order is cancelled before dispatch. Approved refunds are issued within 5–7 business days to your original payment method (bank account or UPI for Cash on Delivery orders).

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes. Request an exchange within 7 days of delivery and we'll send your new size, subject to availability. The same tag and condition rules apply.

settings.question: My tee arrived damaged or wrong. What now?
settings.answer: We're sorry! Message us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos or an unboxing video. We'll replace it at no cost to you.

settings.question: How do the oversized tees fit?
settings.answer: Oversized tees have a drop shoulder and a relaxed, boxy body. Take your usual size for the oversized look, or one size down for a closer fit. Every product page has a size chart.

settings.question: What does GSM mean?
settings.answer: GSM is fabric weight. 190 GSM is light and breathable for everyday wear, 230 GSM is a premium mid-weight, and 250 GSM French Terry and Acid Wash are heavyweight with a structured drape.

settings.question: How should I wash my tee?
settings.answer: Wash cold and inside out, dry in the shade and never iron directly on the print. This keeps the colour and print looking new for longer.

settings.question: My size is out of stock. Can I still get it?
settings.answer: Yes — tap Pre-book on the product page. Depending on the product you can pay in full, pay a small advance, or send a request without paying. We confirm the dispatch date on WhatsApp within 24 hours.

settings.question: What happens to my advance?
settings.answer: Your advance is adjusted in the final bill. If we're unable to fulfil your pre-booking, the advance is refunded in full.

settings.question: Can I print my own design?
settings.answer: Yes. In Zeyov Studio you can upload artwork or add text, place it on the front or back, and see the price instantly — DTF prints from logo size to A2, plus embroidery.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange a custom Studio tee?
settings.answer: No. Tees you design in Zeyov Studio are made only for you, so they can't be returned, refunded or exchanged, including for size. Please check the size chart and your design before ordering. If one arrives damaged, defective or doesn't match the design you approved, we'll remake it free.

settings.question: How do I write a review?
settings.answer: Open the product page and tap Write a review. No account is needed. Reviews are checked before they're published so every review on Zeyov is from a real customer.

settings.question: How long do embroidery designs take?
settings.answer: In-stock embroidered tees ship like any other tee: dispatched in 1–2 days and delivered in 3–7 days. If a design is made to order or pre-booked, it takes about 2 weeks, and we ship everything together when it's ready.
